items.markdown:
Finding the right family lawyer in Brisbane’s eastern suburbs or the Bayside area comes down to balancing specialised expertise with local accessibility.

A targeted shortlist of reputable, highly regarded family law practices servicing Carindale, Wynnum, and surrounding Bayside/East Brisbane regions includes the following:

### 1. Honan Family Law (Coorparoo)

- **Location & Reach:** Based nearby in Coorparoo (right on the edge of Brisbane’s inner-east, easily servicing Carindale and surrounding corridors).[[1]](https://www.familylaw.com.au/law-practice/honan-family-law/)
- **Why they are reputable:** Led by Amy Honan—an Accredited Family Law Specialist practicing exclusively in family law since 2006—this boutique all-female firm is routinely recognized for its stellar client care. They are featured in the *Doyles Guide* Recommended List for Family and Parenting Law.[[1]](https://honanfamilylaw.com.au/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVhOdVh6Vm1PR3g2GAo)
- **Key Reasons to Choose:** They champion a compassionate, practical, and highly strategic out-of-court settlement approach wherever possible, saving clients unnecessary litigation stress and costs, but they retain a strong reputation for advocacy if court intervention becomes unavoidable.[[1]](https://honanfamilylaw.com.au/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVhOdVh6Vm1PR3g2GAo)

### 2. Connor Hunter Lawyers (Wynnum)

- **Location & Reach:** Centrally located in Wynnum, deeply embedded in the Bayside community.[[1]](https://lawconnect.com/en-au/find/family-law/qld/wynnum-4178)
- **Why they are reputable:** Established back in 1971, Connor Hunter is a foundational fixture of Bayside legal services. They provide a multi-disciplinary practice with a dedicated focus on family law, asset division, and child custody arrangements.[[1]](https://lawconnect.com/en-au/find/family-law/qld/wynnum-4178)
- **Key Reasons to Choose:** If you prefer a long-standing, traditional local firm with deep roots in the Wynnum-Manly community rather than a flashy CBD corporate office, Connor Hunter offers stable, highly personal, and community-oriented guidance.[[1]](https://connorhunter.com/)

### 3. Australian Family Lawyers (Manly / Bayside)

- **Location & Reach:** Servicing the Brisbane Bayside area out of Manly.
- **Why they are reputable:** Led locally by experienced practitioners like Danielle Dick, this branch is part of a larger, highly structured national network completely dedicated to family law.
- **Key Reasons to Choose:** Ideal if you want the backing, modern digital resources, and structured framework of a national family law specialist firm, combined with localized Bayside representation for divorce, complex property settlements, and child-related matters.[[1]](https://www.australianfamilylawyers.com.au/locations/manly)

### 4. Barto Du Plessis Solicitors (Carindale)

- **Location & Reach:** Situated directly in Carindale.
- **Why they are reputable:** A highly rated, approachable local practice offering localized convenience right in the heart of the Carindale residential and commercial hub.
- **Key Reasons to Choose:** Excellent for clients looking for a down-to-earth, face-to-face consultation right in Carindale to handle initial separation advice, straightforward property agreements, or preliminary binding financial arrangements without traveling toward the city.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdadU1YZzJNMmMwGAo)

- Are you dealing primarily with **parenting/child custody arrangements** or **financial/property division**?
- Do you prefer a **boutique local specialist** close to Carindale/Wynnum, or an **out-of-court collaborative approach** vs. litigation readiness?
